messages.text: My miner arrived faulty
Used route to tech
Handed to Hal.
I then had a second lilygo screen and attached it and put harlo os on it I then go it to show something and it showed this
Used the store-orders skill

Thanks, I'm back on the order side of this.

That screen confirms it: "BOARD INITIALIZATION FAILED" on a second, known-good LILYGO is the board itself, not the display. Hal has logged it as a genuine hardware fault on your BC04.

The return is with JD and Georges for approval now. They'll confirm it by email shortly, and the return label and next steps come with that. Nothing to send back until you have the label.

Nothing else you need to do tonight.
Ok thanks

You're welcome. Watch for that email, it comes to (email hidden), and worth checking spam.

One thing I'm curious about while you're here: you had a spare LILYGO on hand from another miner, so what else are you running alongside the BC04?
I bought a dc08  on eBay and I was installing harlo os on it

Ah, that explains the spare screen. Harlo OS downloads and release notes are all at harlolabs.com, and the Harlo OS channel on our Discord is the fastest place for hands-on help: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, mention @nullhashrate.

Curious though: you've bought from us twice, so what sent you to eBay for the DC08 rather than here?
Did know of u . I do now and it been a good experience

Good to hear, thanks for saying so.

The BC04 return is still with the team for approval, so that's the one thing still open. You'll get the email with the label and next steps.

Last thing from me: when you do buy your next miner, what decides it for you, the price per TH, the noise and heat at home, or the shot at a solo block?
I’m in Canada so my option are limited but using your company has been seemless

That's good to hear, and Canada is covered properly: we ship from our Canadian warehouse, so no cross-border customs on your end.

I'll leave the BC04 with the team to confirm. Anything else comes up, just open the chat again.
Next miner I buy will be a bigger Harlo one. I like them
Read the bsb b30 page

Good call, the B30 is the bigger Harlo: about 30 TH/s for $899. It's a pre-sale, shipping October 30, and it ships from our Canadian warehouse. You can track the batch on its way to us at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status.

Worth a look alongside it: the Magic M. 40T, $799 for 40 TH/s, pre-sale shipping November 14. Cheapest per TH we sell.

Want me to run the numbers for (address hidden), sats a month and power cost at your rate?
30 or 40t
Ran the power-cost calculator

The 40T, for you.

More hashrate, 40 TH/s against 30, and it's $100 less at $799. Best value per TH we sell, which is why it's the one that sells out. The B30 is a fine unit, just not against that on price.

One trade-off: the 40T ships November 14, the B30 October 30. Two weeks apart.

Both pre-sale, both out of our Canadian warehouse. Want me to point you at the 40T listing?
